create_IMAGENET_ITERATOR: create an ImageNet iterator to traverse local ImageNet dataset files and yield image paths with class IDs
shuffle_IMAGENET_DATASET: shuffle the ImageNet dataset iterator with a random seed for reproducible training data ordering
parse_WORDNET_ID: parse a WordNet ID from a string using regex pattern matching to extract the nXXXXXXXX format
get_IMAGENET_CLASS_MAPPINGS: get the mapping dictionary from WordNet IDs to class indices for all 1000 ILSVRC2012 classes
iterate_IMAGENET_SPLIT: iterate over the train or val split of ImageNet yielding tuples of file paths and class labels
